we propose a novel architecture for the integration of Web services for the support of groupware.

the development of a framework for groupware support in a Web services environment.
the development of a Web service framework that supports groupware applications.
the design and implementation of Web services support for distributed and mobile collaboration, which is an important research topic in the field of groupware.
